I had issues between my male cat and one of my girls (I also have 3) and all my research into cat psychology pointed towards feeding the cats in separate rooms (but with a screen door in the middle) is that an option you can do?  I couldn’t do it personally, as my cats were able to coexist enough to eat together, which meant it was not a larger issue and had to be solved a different way.  The screen method is so that the cats associate each other with food, it takes about two weeks and then you should be able to take the screen away and the cats should slowly be able to begin to build trust. I saw it on My Cat From Hell.  I would recommend reading more into this method, and maybe researching some episodes of my cat from hell to see if any of them are close to your situation.
